sam: Quick thread for MIG-421 orchestration during the midnight quiet window. Im taking the slot at 00:00 UTC and will coordinate.
leah: copying. Ill pin the api and workers to v2.3.0 for safety. Command: `kubectl set image deploy/api api=api:v2.3.0 --record`
mike: backfill size? perf expectations?
marisol: ~120k rows across 6 shards. Conservative run: 150 rps throttle -> expect ~2h. We'll start in dry-run on shard-3 first.
sam: deploybot, schedule: start canary at 00:05 UTC 10% for 8m, then 40% for 12m, then 100% after smoke. If any gate trips, stop rollout.
deploybot: deploybot: received schedule. will post events here. Canary step1 started at 3182040005.
nia: rollback criteria I propose: any of the following triggers abort & immediate rollback:
- canary error rate >3% for 6m
- p95 latency increases by >200ms for 5m
- persistent replica lag >8s for 3 checks
- any DDL lock >45s during apply
leah: also add: if background backfill causes txn_conflicts > 0.8% sustained for 10m, pause backfill and reduce throttle to 30% of current.
mike: agree. Also configure an alert: ops-bot notify #oncall if p95>500ms.
ops-bot: ops-bot: alert rule created: p95_write > 500ms -> notify infra-oncall.
marisol: added a pg snapshot step to preflight: `psql -c "select pid, now()-query_start AS dur, query from pg_stat_activity where state='active'"` and uploaded to runbook.
sam: runbook excerpt:```
- pin services to v2.3.0
- confirm replica lag < 300ms
- start dry-run backfill on shard-3
- throttle backfill: 150 rps (dynamic scale back on lag/conflicts)
- canary: 10%/8m -> 40%/12m -> full if green
- rollback triggers: error rate/latency/replica lag/DDL locks/txn_conflicts
- post-deploy: run schema-verify and smoke tests 15m
```
leah: deploybot: when canary reaches 40%, run `schema-verify` job and then `release-notes: draft` job to capture changes for release notes. If verify fails, stop rollout and tag changelog.
deploybot: deploybot: canary step1 completed at 3182040065, errors stable at 0.7%, p95 up 30ms. Proceeding to step2.
mike: monitoring checklist: watch `write_latency_ms`, `replica_lag_seconds`, `txn_conflicts_pct`. Ill be watching dashboards, ping if anything odd.
marisol: dry-run on shard-3 shows median row processing ~6ms, no locks observed. Moving to shard-1 sample after step2 green.
sam: escalation plan: if DDL lock >45s -> try graceful cancel of migration job; if cancel fails escalate to infra-oncall for emergency kill. Infra-oncall, standby?
infra-oncall: oncall here. note: have a dev-box ready to run `pg_terminate_backend(pid)` if we need to free locks. prefer to pause backfill first.
nia: final acceptance: allow wide rollout only after 15m post-schema-verify smoke on 40% canary and release-notes drafted.
sam: thanks all. Ill keep updates here. If anyone needs to request an abort, say `sam: abort` in this thread and Ill action. :white_check_mark:
